response.text: {"summary":"This repository implements a simple TCP chat system using only the Python standard library. The client program (client.py) reads lines from stdin, sends them to the server, and prints any messages received, while the server (server.py) runs a multi‑client TCP chat server that broadcasts each client’s messages to all others, handling each connection in its own thread. The wire format is defined in protocol.py, which specifies UTF‑8 text lines terminated by \"\\n\" and enforces a maximum line length. The package’s interfaces, chat/client_interface.py::ChatClientInterface and chat/server_interface.py::ChatServerInterface, expose send/receive/close and start/stop/client_count/broadcast methods respectively, tying the command‑line tools to the underlying networking logic."}
